method.order: alternate full/core, core/full each pair; each observation a fresh process
method.cache: Warm filesystem/page cache after two warmup pairs; no OS cache flush; installed bytecode generated by pip
method.timing: Untraced runs only. Parent process wall includes interpreter, marker harness and complete actual-local workflow. Import and first-frame phases begin before Raven imports.
method.memory: Process and largest reaped child peak RSS in KiB; child peaks are not simultaneous aggregate memory. Parent-only Python allocation peaks use separate fresh tracemalloc runs and are never RSS.
method.equivalence: Same existing workflow_probe.py common complete path and stable logical jobs/logs/run/worker/config predicates; raw rendered rows retained, dynamic timestamps not erased from raw evidence.
limits: Experimental unpublished source extraction; not a small-core claim
Synthetic scheduler, actual local launch and managed worker; no live Slurm, GPU or human evidence
Small within-host series, not population confidence intervals or general cold-start claims
Process I/O counters exclude child processes; block bytes may be zero under warm cache
Coordinator-exclusive measurement window; host background activity remains uncontrolled

full.footprint_scope: Raven package only, including installed bytecode; excludes interpreter, pip and stdlib

core.footprint_scope: Raven package only, including installed bytecode; excludes interpreter, pip and stdlib

observations.instrumentation: phase markers; separate tracemalloc runs; common complete path
